title: Populate deck strategy fields in data/decks/ registry
description:
The deck registry in data/decks/ now has a 'strategy' field on every deck JSON, but all values are empty strings. Each deck needs a 1-2 sentence strategy description for blunder analysis context.

The blunder annotator already renders strategy in the Game Overview when present (scripts/analysis/blunder_analysis.py _game_overview). Example output:
  Deck: UW Control — answers threats and grinds card advantage via counterspells and card draw.

Scope:
- 26 Standard decks (WotC starter decks from Wilds of Eldraine)
- 30 Modern decks
- 25 Legacy decks
- 97 Commander precons
- 93 Jumpstart themes (optional — these are half-decks and may not need strategies)

For WotC precons, official descriptions exist on the WotC product pages. For constructed archetypes, use standard Magic terminology (aggro, control, combo, midrange, tempo, etc.) with the deck's key game plan.

Format: Keep each strategy under 200 characters. Focus on win condition and key mechanics, not card-by-card analysis.
